title: Texas Hill Country Flood Relief. You can help, here’s how. #lisakamprathsellsrealestate
description:
🙏 Praying for all impacted by the Texas Hill Country floods. As a Texas REALTOR®️& Family Health Advocate, I’m here to support our neighbors during this time—connecting families to shelter, resources, and real estate solutions in Belton, Temple, Killeen & beyond. If you or someone you know needs help relocating, finding temporary housing, or navigating your next steps, I’m just a message away. 💛
